claim: In the matching retail DLL, MatchSEPlayer.PlayMatchSE (0x06005277) is an instance method with parameters seid, vol and pl_idx and an exact 374-byte body. It returns immediately unless raw seid is in the inclusive range 0..108, resolves PlayerMan.GetPlObj(pl_idx), and loads MatchSEData.GetMatchSEParam(seid). When the Player converts true, an isVibratePad branch clamps MatchSEParam.vibTime to raw 10..60 and, when either vibLevel_Large or vibLevel_Small is nonzero and plCont_Pad exists, calls GamePadMan.SetVibration(port, vibLevel_Large, Float32(vibTime)/60.0f). Raw seid 31 or 32 calls Player.PlayBreathEffect. Raw seid 5 returns when CostumeData.layerTex.Get(8,1) is null/empty or when FormRenderer.pos_OutOfRing is nonzero. Raw seids 7,8,9,10,11,12,13,14 and 58 test pos_OutOfRing and replace seid with raw 48 when nonzero. The shared tail calls MatchUI.Show_Critical(1) when seid is raw 30, returns when rfs_se_wait_list[seid] is nonzero, otherwise stores raw 2 into that element and calls Menu_SoundManager.Play_MatchSE(seid,vol). FACT-0058 pins the canonical caller boundary at MatchMisc.PlayMatchSE IL+0x0059 with the wrapper's three arguments forwarded into this method.
